content.rendered:
“And when he saw them, he said unto them, Go shew yourselves unto the priests. And it came to pass, that, as they went, they were cleansed”
-Luke 17: 14

That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.

As the ten lepers went to present themselves to the priests, it came to pass that they were cleansed. Their healing did not happen immediately they met Jesus; but in the process of time, their healing manifested. Time revealed their results; time revealed their miracle.

Friend, whatever God has destined for you will happen someday, it’s just a matter of time. Your next level will come to you in a matter of time; your increase will come in a matter of time; your promotion will come in a matter of time; you will break your limits in a matter of time.

The miracles and breakthroughs you believe God for will happen in a matter of time; your prayers will be answered in a matter of time; the things you lost will be restored, your challenges will give way, the things that caused you pain will turn around for your good, and God says, it will all be a matter of time.

Cheer up, the days of pain and mourning will soon give way to dancing and celebration. The days of lack will soon give way to ceaseless abundance. Time will compensate you and work for you.

As days turn to weeks and weeks turn to months and months turn to years, God says, time will work for your good.

Pray With Me: Lord, time must give me results, in Jesus’ name!
